name: Continuous RAG Knowledge Ingestion & Support Agent

parameters.query: INSERT INTO rag.document_embeddings (doc_id, doc_title, section_title, chunk_index, content, embedding, metadata) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6::vector, $7::jsonb) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
parameters.queryParams: ={{ [$('Semantic Markdown Chunker').item.json.doc_id, $('Semantic Markdown Chunker').item.json.doc_title, $('Semantic Markdown Chunker').item.json.section_title, $('Semantic Markdown Chunker').item.json.chunk_index, $('Semantic Markdown Chunker').item.json.content, '[' + $json.data[0].embedding.join(',') + ']', JSON.stringify({ category: $('Semantic Markdown Chunker').item.json.category })].join('|||') }}

parameters.responseBody:
={
  "status": "SUCCESS",
  "doc_id": "{{ $('Semantic Markdown Chunker').first().json.doc_id }}",
  "total_chunks": {{ $('Semantic Markdown Chunker').all().length }},
  "indexed_at": "{{ new Date().toISOString() }}",
  "vector_store": "pgvector"
}

parameters.query: SELECT doc_id, doc_title, section_title, content, 1 - (embedding <=> $1::vector) AS similarity FROM rag.document_embeddings ORDER BY embedding <=> $1::vector LIMIT 3;

parameters.responseBody:
={
  "status": "ESCALATED_TO_HUMAN",
  "customer_id": "{{ $json.customer_id }}",
  "confidence_score": {{ $json.confidence_score }},
  "escalation_reason": "{{ $json.escalation_reason }}",
  "response": "Your request has been routed directly to our senior enterprise support desk for priority handling. A specialist will review your account details and follow up promptly."
}
